INSERT INTO MEMBER (MEMBER_ID, MEMBER_NAME, BIRTH, GENDER, LOGIN_ID, LOGIN_PW, NICKNAME, EMAIL, PHONE, ROLE) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{memberName}, #{birth}, #{gender}, #{loginId}, #{loginPw}, #{nickname}, #{email}, #{phone}, #{role})

SELECT MEMBER_ID, GRADE_ID, TOTAL_AMOUNT, MEMBER_NAME, BIRTH, GENDER, LOGIN_ID, LOGIN_PW, NICKNAME, EMAIL, CREATED_AT, PHONE, ROLE, MEMBER_STATUS, TO_CHAR(BIRTH, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS BIRTH_STR, TO_CHAR(CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS CREATED_AT_STR FROM MEMBER WHERE LOGIN_ID = #{loginId}

SELECT M.MEMBER_ID, GRADE_ID, TOTAL_AMOUNT, MEMBER_NAME, BIRTH, GENDER, LOGIN_ID, LOGIN_PW, NICKNAME, EMAIL, M.CREATED_AT, PHONE, ROLE, MEMBER_STATUS, P.POINT, TO_CHAR(BIRTH, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS BIRTH_STR, TO_CHAR(M.CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS CREATED_AT_STR, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM COUPONHISTORY H WHERE M.MEMBER_ID = H.MEMBER_ID AND H.TYPE='ISSUE') AS ISSUE FROM MEMBER M LEFT JOIN MEMBERPOINT P ON M.MEMBER_ID = P.MEMBER_ID WHERE M.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}

SELECT C.COUPON_ID, C.COUPON_NAME, C.COUPON_VALUE, C.COUPON_TEXT, C.CREATED_AT, C.DEADLINE, TO_CHAR(C.CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS CREATED_AT_STR, TO_CHAR(C.DEADLINE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS DEAD_LINE_STR FROM COUPONHISTORY CH JOIN COUPON C ON CH.COUPON_ID = C.COUPON_ID WHERE CH.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND CH.TYPE='ISSUE'

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM WISH WHERE PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID) AS COUNT_WISH, P.PRODUCT_NAME, PI.PRODUCT_IMAGE_PATH, PI.PRODUCT_IMAGE_SAVE_NAME, (SELECT NVL(ROUND(AVG(R.SCORE), 1), 0) FROM OPTIONDETAIL POP JOIN ORDERDETAIL OD ON POP.POP_ID = OD.POP_ID JOIN REVIEW R ON OD.OD_ID = R.OD_ID WHERE POP.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID) AS REVIEW_AVG FROM WISH W JOIN PRODUCT P ON W.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID JOIN PRODUCTIMAGE PI ON P.PRODUCT_ID = PI.PRODUCT_ID WHERE W.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND PI.PRODUCT_TITLE_IMAGE = 0

SELECT C.CART_ID, C.QTY, PO.OPTION_ID, PO.OPTION_NAME, PO.OPTION_PRICE, PO.OPTION_STOCK, P.PRODUCT_ID, P.PRODUCT_NAME, PI.PRODUCT_IMAGE_PATH, PI.PRODUCT_IMAGE_SAVE_NAME FROM CART C JOIN OPTIONDETAIL POP ON C.POP_ID = POP.POP_ID JOIN PRODUCTOPTION PO ON POP.OPTION_ID = PO.OPTION_ID JOIN PRODUCT P ON POP.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID JOIN PRODUCTIMAGE PI ON P.PRODUCT_ID = PI.PRODUCT_ID WHERE C.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND PI.PRODUCT_TITLE_IMAGE = 0

SELECT D.DELIVERY_ID, D.COMPANY, D.TRACKING_NO, D.DELIVERY_STATUS, PO.DETAIL_ADDRESS_FIX, PO.ADDRESS_NAME_FIX, PO.ORDER_ID, PO.TOTAL_PRICE, PO.ORDER_STATUS, PO.ORDER_DATE, TO_CHAR(PO.ORDER_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS ORDER_DATE_STR FROM DELIVERY D JOIN PRODUCTORDER PO ON D.ORDER_ID = PO.ORDER_ID WHERE PO.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} ORDER BY PO.ORDER_DATE DESC

SELECT P.PRODUCT_NAME, PI.PRODUCT_IMAGE_PATH, PI.PRODUCT_IMAGE_SAVE_NAME FROM PRODUCTORDER PO JOIN ORDERDETAIL OD ON PO.ORDER_ID = OD.ORDER_ID JOIN OPTIONDETAIL POP ON OD.POP_ID = POP.POP_ID JOIN PRODUCT P ON POP.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID JOIN PRODUCTIMAGE PI ON P.PRODUCT_ID = PI.PRODUCT_ID WHERE PO.ORDER_ID = #{orderId} AND PI.PRODUCT_TITLE_IMAGE = 0 FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
